title: Some Sing That He Watches Over Us
summary: Control is being answered in the middle of pressure, not after the day has calmed down.
takeaway: Some sing that He watches over us, face to face, ever-present; some sing of His Power-who has that Power
lifeApplication: Release one demand that peace must wait for total control. Use the line before the pressure chooses your tone.
